question: we have room for 2 game changers... with a surveil on the battlefield, worldy tutor in previous players end step to put it ontop, and then surveil to graveyard is nice, vampiric is nice too.. could do it

contributions.text:
Add both tutors, cutting Six and Vile Entomber; NO CHANGE elsewhere; Eyeless Watcher stays parked. Argument only: no stack and no goldfish row has tested the line.
1. Rules: the line is right. Worldly Tutor: instant, {G}, creature card only, on top (S-60d6f4e6-03) — cannot find Reanimate, Animate Dead, Cauldron or a noncreature outlet. Vampiric Tutor: instant, {B}, any card, on top, lose 2 life (S-60d6f4e6-06). Unshakable Tail surveils 1 at the beginning of our upkeep, before the draw (bin it or keep it; a binned creature card also investigates). Nyx Weaver mills two at upkeep: bins it for certain plus a free extra mill. With neither on board, the tutor is an instant-speed Demonic Tutor on mana otherwise wasted (strategy:deckbuilding.redundancy-vs-tutors); holding mana up leaves the table guessing (strategy:multiplayer.pod-management). Best finds: Worldly — the missing engine half (Ophiomancer, Constrictor) or a fatty to bin (Archon, Sheoldred) with Tail or Weaver out; Vampiric — whatever the board lacks (Reanimate or Cauldron once a fatty is in the yard, or the free outlet). Study 010's doctor: tutoring lifts the outlet-plus-fodder pair by T6 (goldfish, unopposed) — an argument for tutors over a third fodder body.
2. Cuts: Six — mills only when it attacks; a 3-mana 2/4 attacking into a table is the card least tied to the end step, and Tail, Weaver, Wayfinder, Supplier and Diviner fill the yard. Vile Entomber — a 4-mana sorcery-speed load; Entomb, Buried Alive, Fauna Shaman, Formidable Speaker and now two tutors do that job (function neighbours Speaker, Entomb). Weighed and kept: Woe Strider (free outlet, the self-feeding thesis), Ozox (three-card lines), Stitcher's Supplier and Satyr Wayfinder (self-feeding bodies), Sylvan Library (pairs with a tutored top card), Sol Ring. Fallback if Entomber stays: Blasting Station. Eyeless Watcher: fodder is not the bottleneck by study 010; a tutor beats it for a slot.
3. Life: Vampiric's 2 life is minor; skip it on a turn that stacks Reanimate on a big fatty, Dark Prophecy, Bitterblossom and Fell Stinger.
Open: does the goldfish model end-step tutors and Tail's top-of-library surveil? A scenario slice or rules check is the lightest test of the line.

call.pilot_words: approve, make the swap; next please [Vampiric Tutor for Vile Entomber] / no change on worldly, sIX IS A GREAT CARD! save
call.reading: Vampiric Tutor replaces Vile Entomber, the most redundant yard loader: cast at the previous player's end step with the card on top, Unshakable Tail's surveil or Nyx Weaver's mill bins it at our upkeep, or we draw it. Worldly Tutor is held: no cut was clearly worth it, and the pilot keeps Six. The goldfish does not run the end-step tutor and surveil line, so the call rests on the card and the pilot.
